# Reunion Global — LLM Context File

> Reunion Global Private Ltd. is Coastal Karnataka's most trusted luxury hospitality brand, managing 17+ premium properties across Udupi district, Karnataka, India.

## About Reunion Global

Reunion Global Private Ltd. was founded in 2020 with a mission to redefine coastal tourism. We manage premium beach villas, oceanfront cafés, boutique hotels, and city villas — curated for families, couples, and groups who gather in style.

- **Website**: https://www.reunionglobal.in
- **Headquarters**: Udupi, Karnataka, India
- **Founded**: 2020
- **Managing Director & CEO**: Mrs. Kshama Kadamba

## Property Portfolio

### Beach Villas & Coastal Properties

- **Ocean Elite** — 2BHK villa with direct beach access, beach-view balcony, spacious lawn | Padutonse, Udupi | Up to 6 guests | Generator backup
- **Ocean Manor** — Multi-level retreat with sea-facing & river-facing bedrooms, beach-facing balcony | Padutonse, Udupi | Multiple units | Generator backup
- **Ocean Givaah** — 3BHK luxury villa with private pool (4ft), ocean-view terrace, lush garden | Bada, Udupi | Up to 9 guests | 200m from beach
- **Ocean Royal** — Heritage farmhouse villa, 50m from beach, coconut tree surroundings | Kapu, Udupi | Up to 15 guests | Generator backup
- **Ocean Daaffy** — 3BHK villa, 100m from beach, peaceful natural setting | Bada, Udupi | Up to 9 guests | UPS backup
- **Ocean Hridayam** — 2BHK beachfront villa with beach-facing balcony, split-level design | Mattu, Udupi | Up to 6 guests
- **Ocean Bliss** — 2BHK property, 800m from beach, open compound | Malpe, Udupi | Up to 6 guests
- **Ocean Waves** — 3 independent units, just 5m from beach, CCTV surveillance | Mattu, Udupi | Multiple rooms

### City Villas & Urban Stays

- **De Homes** — Premium suites in Udupi city center near Sri Krishna Matha | Chitpady, Udupi | 16 premium rooms | Standard to Presidential
- **Marina Villa** — 3BHK city villa with AC, WiFi, parking | Kannarpady, Udupi | Up to 10 guests
- **Charm Villa** — 3BHK first-floor property with basic amenities | Badagabettu, Udupi | Up to 9 guests
- **Aradhya Villa** — 4BHK multi-level villa with bathtub suite, 700m from Krishna Temple | Kunjibettu, Udupi | Up to 12 guests
- **Arya** — 2 independent 1BHK studio rooms | Kunjibettu, Udupi | Up to 3 guests each
- **Krshna** — 2BHK furnished villa in Manipal | Manipal, Udupi | Up to 6 guests
- **Regal Villa** — 2BHK with balcony, terrace, free parking | Chitpady, Udupi | Up to 6 guests
- **Villa** — 3BHK with garden & terrace views, meal arrangements available | Chitpady, Udupi | Up to 10 guests

### Dining & Café

- **Reunion Ocean Café** — Beachfront café at Mattu Beach with continental & Chinese cuisine, seafood, specialty coffee, candlelight dinners | Mattu Beach, Udupi | Open 9:30 AM – 10:00 PM

## Key Locations

All properties are located in and around Udupi district, Coastal Karnataka, India:

- **Padutonse** — Direct beachfront villas
- **Bada** — Quiet beach retreats
- **Kapu** — Heritage coastal area with lighthouse
- **Mattu / Mattu Beach** — Serene beachfront stays and café
- **Malpe** — Popular beach destination
- **Chitpady** — City center near Sri Krishna Matha
- **Kunjibettu** — Central Udupi neighborhood
- **Kannarpady** — Udupi city area
- **Badagabettu** — Residential area
- **Manipal** — University town

## Site Structure

- `/` — Homepage with featured properties, destination highlights, testimonials
- `/properties` — Full collection of all properties with masonry grid
- `/properties/[id]` — Individual property detail pages with gallery, amenities, FAQs, map
- `/about` — About Reunion, team members, company story

## Common Amenities Across Properties

WiFi, Air Conditioning, Fully Equipped Kitchen, Power Backup (Generator or UPS), Parking, Beach Access (varies by property), CCTV Security (select properties), Food Delivery Available
